```sql
-- name: audit_log_page
-- owner: compliance
-- params: tenant_id, table_name, row_id, from, to, limit, offset
-- One page of the audit trail, newest first. table_name and row_id are
-- optional; pass NULL to skip the filter.
SELECT a.id,
       a.tenant_id,
       a.table_name,
       a.row_id,
       a.action,
       a.old_data,
       a.new_data,
       a.actor_id,
       a.is_system,
       a.created_at
  FROM audit_log a
 WHERE a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
   AND (%(table_name)s::text IS NULL OR a.table_name = %(table_name)s)
   AND (%(row_id)s::uuid IS NULL OR a.row_id = %(row_id)s)
   AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
   AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s OFFSET %(offset)s
```

De query draait al in 0,3 ms. Hij gebruikt `audit_log_tenant_created_at_idx` achterwaarts en een incremental sort, en leest maar 180 buffers. Een herschrijving zou hooguit de leesbaarheid of de planstabiliteit riskeren, zonder meetbare winst. Daarom geef ik de originele query ongewijzigd terug.
